headline.text: L1 S3 metal detector caught *ferrous fragment* between biscuit and caramel — investigation open; L3 ML4 metal shavings from damaged cleaning blade; two active holds across L1 S4 and L3 MFM.

summary: Three metal-related events today: L1 S3 metal detector rejection (fragment between layers, source unknown), L3 ML4 metal shavings from damaged cleaning-roller blade, and L2 ML3 degrading plastic paddle removed. Two holds active: L1 S4 underweight caramel (2 pallets), L3 MFM mixed lots (3 pallets).

holds.title: Two pallets held for underweight caramel
holds.summary: S4 line placed two pallets on hold between 02:30 and 03:10 due to low caramel weight; average piece weight ranged 9.8–10.2 g.

holds.title: Three FG pallets held for mixed lots
holds.summary: MF Matrix discovered mixed lot codes in finished-goods pallets after pallet with different dates entered hopper; three pallets segregated.
holds.status: On hold; QA preparing formal rework instructions.

food_safety.title: Metal fragment in S3 product caught by detector
food_safety.summary: QA found magnetic metal fragment between biscuit base and caramel layer during weight check; metal detector rejected the piece; maintenance investigating source.
food_safety.status: Investigation ongoing — maintenance unable to identify origin; ferrous, caught at detector.

food_safety.title: Metal shavings on ML4 TG5 conveyor belt
food_safety.summary: Metal shavings found on end conveyor belt of TG5 during level 3 clean; suspected source is damaged cleaning-roller blade from earlier incident.
food_safety.status: Resolved — no metal found in drain strainer post-clean; blade replaced, equipment ATP-cleared.

food_safety.title: Degrading plastic paddle removed from ML3
food_safety.summary: Plastic tool used to push chocolate into PTL showed wear and was shedding particles; removed from line to prevent foreign material contamination.
food_safety.status: Resolved — tool removed from service; no product impact identified.

quality.title: S2 lid tightener fell off during operation
quality.summary: Lid tightener fell off and line continued running without it before crew re-installed; potential for loose lids in that window.
quality.status: Resolved — tightener re-installed; no formal count of affected product taken.

quality.title: Six deformed jars flagged on S2 jar line
quality.summary: Second-shift team caught six jars that appeared very deformed and thin; samples placed on Charity's desk for review.
quality.status: Resolved — six jars out of millions purchased; samples saved for supplier review.

sanitation.title: ML1 rice-test filters 5 and 6 missing
sanitation.summary: QA unable to perform rice-capture test on ML1 because filters 5 and 6 were missing from line and dishwasher area; later found by end of shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved — filters located and test performed.

opportunities.text: Add lid-tightener presence check to S2 startup and post-jam checklist — today's unit fell off and ran undetected until crew noticed.
Inspect all plastic hand tools at ML3 for wear and create replacement schedule — today's degrading paddle was shedding particles into food-contact zone.
Consider adding cleaning-roller blade inspection to ML4 startup checklist — today's damaged blade and possible metal shavings echo the need for pre-shift verification.
Review metal-detector rice-test filter storage protocol — second shift and third shift both reported filters 5 and 6 missing from ML1 staging area.
